title: SoA Consolidation Corrections Schema
description: Human decisions on a protocol's cross-table activity matches. One file per protocol, next to the consolidated file; consolidation reads it before matching. Entries name source rows (table_number + activity_id, with activity_name as a check), never unified-activity ids, which are not stable across input changes. The Layer 3 analogue of soa-table-corrections.

protocol_id.description: Protocol whose consolidation this sidecar corrects.

id.description: Entry identifier, unique within this file (e.g. 'ccorr-001').

op.description: keep=consolidation's result for the pair stands: 'source' stays merged with 'target', or stays separate from its near match 'target'; split='source' is taken out of the unified activity it shares with 'target' and becomes an activity of its own; merge='source' joins the unified activity of 'target'; refines='source' (a row or a whole table) details the row 'target', nothing is merged. An entry whose premise no longer holds (a row renamed, a 'keep' or 'split' of a merge that no longer happens, a 'merge' that now happens by itself) stops consolidation.

source.description: The row the decision is about: the later-consolidated row of the pair. For 'refines' it may be a whole table (table_number only).

target.description: The other row of the pair: a row of the unified activity 'source' is merged with, kept apart from, taken out of, joined to, or refines. Its table must be consolidated before the source's table.

corrections.description: The decisions, one entry per pair of rows (for 'refines': per row or table and the row it details).

activity_id.description: activity_id of the row in that table.

activity_name.description: The row's activity_name, carried as a check: it must equal the name in the resolved table.

row.description: A source row: one activity row of one resolved table.

activity_id.description: activity_id of the row in that table. Absent when a whole table is meant ('refines' only).

activity_name.description: The row's activity_name, carried as a check.

row_or_table.description: A source row, or a whole resolved table when only table_number is given ('refines' only).
